items.description: Beanvest is an investment portfolio tracking application. It allows you to keep track of all your investments in one place with helpful insights.

Connected with the Walgreens Balance Rewards program, this fitbit application allow users to keep track of their activity to earn Walgreens points. With a 'steps' program, customers will be able to set goals and view progress of their activities, while earning reward points at Walgreens.

With this GoogleMaps mashup, you can see exactly where your hotel at Copacabana Beach, Brazil would be, with photos, videos, and online reservation directly from the map, ranked from the hotels on the beach to the hostels elsewere in Copacabana.

Need to create a map for your Facebook page? Why send readers to a google or mapquest map when you could give them another reason to go to your Facebook page instead? Or keep them on your Facebook page. The BlockWild map application gives you the ability to create a map with an informative popup card on your Facebook page for events, rentals, classifieds, or anything you want to map.
Advanced search tool for YouTube videos using Google Maps. Query results by category, upload date, time, city and keyword.
FiWiStore provides a pleasant online shopping experience for internet user. Search, buy and review products through our easy to use online store.
Zenoss Core is an open source systems management platform that monitors your whole infrastructure. Starting with version 2.1, all geographical network data is overlaid on Google Maps.

Italianwinesandfood.com is a mashup project to promote the best of Italian products, but also wine tours in Italy. In a easy-to-use map we collected the main typical Italian products divided by types and geographic locations. In particular our purpose is enabling a rapid and intuitive consultation of the map to discover the typical Italian products and the main Italian wines.
Takes data submitted with a Formstack form and creates corresponding event entries on a Google Calendar.
Shows US neighborhood boundaries and neighborhood names, pulling from Maponics Neighborhood Boundaries GIS mapping data.

Weight can fluctuate depending on a person's activity and diets. It can be hard to predict how the body will react in certain scenarios. With that said, WeightGrapher is an application that reveals trends in the person's weight. It helps people reach their diet and exercise goals by enabling them to see past the daily ups and downs. Their motto is 'ignore the weight: follow the trend'.
Track the most popular news and other threads online via RSSmeme. Integrates with FriendFeed API.

DPhotoIndex is a website that aims to provide information with sample photos taken with certain cameras and lenses. Brief reviews of cameras and lenses are accompanied by series of photos retrieved from Flickr. This way, the visitor is able to see real examples of the capability and functionality of particular cameras and lenses.
The BP Gulf oil spill - via an underwater view in Google Earth (approximate location).
Zangoa allows you to discover rural accommodations in Spain and to learn about their environment.
A Pentomino Puzzle. It is created by using the OpenLayers Mapping API. Move, rotate and reflect the 12 pieces to find a solution for the rectangles layout.
Google Mashup of EVDO network coverage, as reported by users in the field. Visitors can see where Sprint and Verizon EVDO coverage performs well, and where it does not.

Akcelerant is a web application that focuses its development to provide services to the financial industry. The DocuSign Akcelerant Integration allows customers to transfer lending documents to distribute for eSignature.

Bitcoin Digital Downloads is a complete solution that allows you to automate the delivery of digital products after your customers pay you using Bitcoin. Bitcoin Digital Downloads can also be used as a Bitcoin payment terminal allowing you to receive Bitcoin payments for things like freelance or contract work, donations and more. Download links are encrypted to prevent unauthorized downloads and can also have an expiry time.
Randolunch selects a random restaurant for you to try based on your location. Perfect for when you can't decide where to eat!
Full-featured mobile Twitter site that runs on every phone. Enables posts longer that 140 characters and presents replies as conversations.
